title: How a Man of God Loses an Argument Without Losing Himself
caption:
Most of us would rather be right than be close.

A man of God can lose an argument and walk away steadier than when he started. Listen until you can say his point back. Say you were wrong without the hedge. Let the sting shrink your pride. Protect the friendship over the scoreboard.

Save this for the next time you feel yourself digging in.

#faith #godlyman #humility #christianmen
